actions.command: cd /app && (command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-aarch64 || command -v qemu-system-arm || true) && file alpine.iso alpine-disk.qcow2

cd /app && (nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,format=raw,media=cdrom -boot d >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid; sleep 2; cat /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid; echo '---LOG---'; sed -n '1,120p' /tmp/alpine-qemu.log)
